title: Bounded blocking queue
prompt:
Implement a bounded blocking queue on top of one intrinsic monitor
(synchronized + wait/notifyAll).

  Solution(int capacity)   // keep this constructor - the grader calls new Solution(2)
  void put(int value)      // append; block while the queue already holds `capacity` items
  int take()               // remove and return the oldest item; block while empty

Rules:
- FIFO: items come out in the order they went in.
- Block, never spin: wait() inside a while loop, and wake with notifyAll().
  notify() can hand the wakeup to the wrong side (producers and consumers share
  one monitor) and lose it.
- Several producers and consumers run at once: nothing may be lost or handed out twice.

Keep the constructor and both signatures exactly as given: no `throws` (handle
InterruptedException inside - the grader never interrupts these threads) and
nothing `private`.
